title: 第18章 遇故人陨石雨停止第19章 邪帝重伤
content_zh:
“还没结束嘛？”众人处理陨石已经一个小时了，一个小时内邪帝四发魔神全用了！
对付附有神境力量陨石雨消耗实在是太大了，战神众人不仅各种武技狂开，既要保护一部分受伤修士撤退，还要尽可能护住一些建筑。
“我感觉我们保护了个寂寞。”神君看着已经几乎变为废墟的城镇。
陨石雨太密集了，一不小心可能就漏了一颗砸落地面，造成大范围的损伤。
有些城镇已然没有修士守护，伤亡无数，满地狼藉。
“别emo了，还没结束！”邪帝将还在忧伤中的神君拉了回来。
“还有啊！？”炎君人都麻了。
“最后一波了，星空外已经没有陨石了。你们留点能量，最后一波我来。”邪帝透过死灵眼看见了星空的情况。
“你一个人来？知道了。”
“圣剑！”邪帝伸手点向陈家的方向，从陈家邪帝院落内飞出12把圣剑。
“去！残暴剑意！”邪帝手指一挥，12把圣剑朝12个方向用接近光速的速度飞去。
12把圣剑各自拖着一道雷光，犹如一条条巨龙在天空中咆哮着，那雷光闪烁之间，仿佛蕴含着无尽的力量和威严。它们所过之处，都带着一股雷霆之意的死亡气息，这种气息让人感到心悸和恐惧。
很快，这十二把圣剑就停留在了九天神国的边界处。它们静静地悬浮在空中，散发着令人窒息的威压。每一把圣剑都像是一座巨大的山岳，给人一种无法撼动的感觉。
在这些圣剑的周围，空间似乎都变得扭曲起来，隐隐约约可以看到一些奇异的符文和光芒。
12把圣剑绽放出无尽光芒，形成一个巨大无比的光罩，将整个九天神国数万辽阔无垠的疆土完全笼罩其中，仿佛是一个牢不可破的结界一般！
“大手笔啊邪帝。”神君感受到了飞过的圣剑。
“搞快点啊邪帝，要落下来了。”圣君催促道。
“叫什么？万剑苍极阵！起！”十二道雷光连接上暗血剑，以暗血剑为阵眼，邪帝施展他所研发的顶级剑阵。
邪帝眼神凌厉，双手紧紧握住暗血剑，他将剑身朝上托起。
随着邪帝的动作，一个巨大的阵法在他脚下浮现出来。它以摧枯拉朽之姿迅速展开，无数道剑气纵横交错，形成了一道坚不可摧的屏障。

而此时，最后一波陨石雨也如暴风雨般袭来。这些陨石带着毁灭一切的力量，狠狠地砸向万剑苍极阵。然而，阵法中的剑气却丝毫不受影响，它们如同灵动的游鱼一般，轻松地穿梭于陨石之间，将那些庞大的陨石一一击碎。
在这惊心动魄的一幕中，邪帝宛如战神降临，他的身影在光芒中显得无比高大。而万剑苍极阵则像是一座无法逾越的堡垒，守护着这片天地的安宁。
“又被邪帝大哥装上了。”女帝看着快要消灭殆尽的陨石雨。
数分钟后，原本喧嚣嘈杂、乱石横飞的天地逐渐恢复平静，仿佛一场盛大而又狂暴的交响乐终于落下帷幕。那些从天而降的陨石如雨点般砸落，溅起无数尘埃和火花，但现在它们已悄然停歇。天空中的乌云渐渐散去，露出了清澈湛蓝的底色；地面上满目疮痍，到处都是被陨石撞击出的大坑小洞，以及散落的碎石块和尘土。一阵清风拂过，带着淡淡的硝烟味，似乎在诉说着刚刚过去的那场惊心动魄的灾难。
“帮我回收一下圣剑。”邪帝声音好像有点虚弱。
“你装逼还要我们擦屁股？”神君嘴上这么说，但已经驾驭光明龙前往边界处了。
“又在叫了。”
“我们仨先躺了，你俩忙吧。”圣君炎君女帝三人已经快要支撑不住了。他们仨没有邪帝神君那么变态。
“躺吧躺吧。还好，魔神无论距离多远都能用到，不然只怕大家不能撑那么久吧。”邪帝望着不再有陨石落下的天空，又看了看遍地碎屑的地面，“新年啧啧，没法过咯。”
这时，邪帝瞥见，废墟之上有个少女，邪帝缓缓从空中落下，向少女走去。少女的面容越来越清晰，少女容颜极佳，足以跟圣君女帝等人媲美，一身黑色羽绒服，修长的长腿配上黑色紧身裤，穿着双白色板鞋，看着走近的邪帝。
“我当是谁呢，原来是你啊，你怎么不去避难？”邪帝看清是谁后，笑了。
“你觉得我需要去避难嘛，去避难了可就看不见你处理陨石帅气的样子了。”少女耸耸肩。
“呵，也是，以你的能力的确不用去。好久不见啊，顾千言。”
“好久不见，邪帝。”
content_en:
"Isn't it over yet?" Everyone has been dealing with the meteorite for an hour, and within an hour the Evil Emperor used all four of his demonic weapons!
It was too costly to deal with the meteorite rain with divine power. Not only did the God of War use various martial arts wildly, they also had to protect some of the injured monks from retreating, and they also had to protect some buildings as much as possible.
"I feel like we protected a lonely person." Shenjun looked at the town that had almost become ruins.
The meteorite rain is so dense that if you are not careful, one may miss and hit the ground, causing extensive damage.
Some towns no longer have monks to guard them, suffering numerous casualties and leaving the ground in a mess.
"Stop being emo, it's not over yet!" The Evil Emperor pulled back the sad Lord.
"There's more!?" Yan Jun was numb.
"It's the last wave. There are no more meteorites outside the starry sky. Save some energy and I will come for the last wave." The Evil Emperor saw the situation in the starry sky through the eyes of the undead.
"You come alone? Got it."
"Holy Sword!" The Evil Emperor reached out and pointed in the direction of the Chen family, and 12 holy swords flew out from the Evil Emperor's courtyard of the Chen family.
"Go! Brutal Sword Intention!" The Evil Emperor waved his finger, and 12 holy swords flew in 12 directions at a speed close to the speed of light.
Each of the 12 holy swords dragged a beam of lightning, like giant dragons roaring in the sky. The lightning flashes seemed to contain endless power and majesty. Wherever they pass, they carry a thunderous aura of death, which makes people feel palpitated and frightened.
Soon, these twelve holy swords stopped at the border of Jiutian Divine Kingdom. They float quietly in the air, exuding a suffocating pressure. Every holy sword is like a huge mountain, giving people an unshakable feeling.
Around these holy swords, the space seemed to become distorted, and some strange runes and lights could be vaguely seen.
The 12 holy swords burst out with endless light, forming a huge light shield that completely enveloped the entire Jiutian Divine Kingdom's tens of thousands of vast territories, as if it were an unbreakable barrier!
"A generous move, Evil Emperor." The Divine Lord felt the flying holy sword.
"Hurry up, Evil Emperor, he's about to fall." The Holy Lord urged.
"What's it called? Ten Thousand Swords Cangji Formation! Get up!" Twelve rays of lightning connected to the Dark Blood Sword. Using the Dark Blood Sword as the eye of the formation, the Evil Emperor used the top sword formation he had developed.
The Evil Emperor's eyes were sharp, he held the Dark Blood Sword tightly with both hands, and he held the sword upward.
Following the Evil Emperor's movements, a huge formation emerged under his feet. It unfolded rapidly in a destructive manner, and countless sword energy crisscrossed it, forming an indestructible barrier.
At this time, the last wave of meteorite rain also hit like a storm. These meteorites hit the Wanjian Cangji Formation with the power to destroy everything. However, the sword energy in the formation was not affected at all. Like agile swimming fish, they easily shuttled between the meteorites and shattered the huge meteorites one by one.
In this thrilling scene, the Evil Emperor descended like a god of war, his figure appearing extremely tall in the light. The Ten Thousand Swords Cangji Formation is like an insurmountable fortress, guarding the tranquility of this world.
"The evil emperor brother installed it again." The empress looked at the meteorite rain that was about to be wiped out.
A few minutes later, the originally noisy and chaotic world gradually returned to calm, as if a grand and violent symphony had finally come to an end. Those meteorites falling from the sky fell like raindrops, splashing countless dust and sparks, but now they have quietly stopped. The dark clouds in the sky gradually dispersed, revealing a clear blue background; the ground was devastated, with large and small holes made by meteorites everywhere, as well as scattered gravel and dust. A breeze blew by, carrying a faint smell of gunpowder smoke, which seemed to tell the story of the thrilling disaster that had just passed.
"Help me recover the holy sword."The Evil Emperor's voice seemed a little weak.
"Are you pretending to be cool and want us to wipe your ass?" Shen Jun said this, but he had already driven the light dragon to the border.
"It's barking again."
"The three of us will lie down first, and you two can get busy." The three of them, Holy Lord Yanjun and Empress, were almost unable to hold on any longer. The three of them are not as perverted as the Evil Emperor and God Lord.
"Lie down, lie down. Fortunately, the Demon God can use it no matter how far away it is, otherwise I'm afraid we won't be able to hold on for that long." The Evil Emperor looked at the sky where there were no more meteorites falling, and then looked at the debris-strewn ground, "Tsk, tsk, New Year, I can't celebrate it."
At this time, the Evil Emperor caught a glimpse of a girl on top of the ruins. The Evil Emperor slowly fell from the sky and walked toward the girl. The girl's face became clearer and clearer. The girl's appearance was excellent, comparable to that of the Holy Emperor and others. She was wearing a black down jacket, long slender legs with black tights, and a pair of white sneakers. She looked at the evil emperor who was approaching.
"Who do I think it is? It turns out to be you. Why don't you take refuge?" The Evil Emperor smiled after seeing who it was.
"Do you think I need to take refuge? If I take refuge, I won't be able to see you handling meteorites so handsomely." The girl shrugged.
"Oh, that's right. With your ability, you really don't need to go. Long time no see, Gu Qianyan."
"Long time no see, Evil Emperor."
